course.name: 口语3000句 · 享受余暇时间 · 邀请友人～去听音乐会

explanations:
`Are you free...` 询问是否有空。常见错误：
• "Do you **have** free" → 不自然，have free time 才搭配 have
• "Are you **freed**" → free 是形容词，不是动词过去式
`this weekend` 前不加介词（不说 on this weekend，尽管美语偶尔加 on，但 this weekend 最简洁常用）。

items.sentence: I'm going to meet a friend for lunch.
items.translation: 我打算和朋友一起吃午饭。
explanations:
**be going to** 表示"计划、打算做某事"。常见错误：
• "I will going" → will 后面不能加 ing
• "I go to meet" → 缺少 be going to 结构，语气也不够自然
**meet** 是原形动词，因为前面有 "going to" 搭配。不要写成 "meeting"（那需要 am going to meeting，重复了）。
**for + 名词** 表示目的。这里 for lunch = 为了吃午餐。不要用 "to lunch"（to 后面要接动词原形）。

sentenceAudio.text: I'm going to meet a friend for lunch.

items.sentence: Let's grab a coffee after work.
items.translation: 下班后一起去喝杯咖啡吧。
explanations:
**Let's = Let us**，表示建议或邀请。常见错误：
• 写成 **Let us** → 太正式，口语用 Let's
• **grab** 在这里不是'抓'，是口语化的'去吃/去喝'

**work** 作'上班'讲时是不可数名词，不加 the。常见错误：
• after **the** work → 错误
• after **working** → 语法正确但 after work 更简洁常用

sentenceAudio.text: Let's grab a coffee after work.

items.sentence: Are you doing anything this evening?
explanations:
**Are you doing anything...?** 是问对方近期安排的标准开头。用现在进行时表将来计划。常见错误：
• "Do you doing anything" → 疑问句 be 要提前
• "Are you **do** anything" → 进行时需要 doing
**this evening** 前不加介词（on this evening ❌）。想约人时可接：Are you doing anything this evening? — 我想约你看电影。

sentenceAudio.text: Are you doing anything this evening?

items.sentence: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I'm busy.
items.translation: 我很想去，但恐怕我没空。
explanations:
**I'd love to, but...** 是拒绝邀请的礼貌句式（先肯定再转折）。常见错误：
• "I'd love **it**, but" → 这里 to 代替整句（I'd love to go），不用 it
• 直接说 No → 太生硬，不礼貌
**I'm afraid** 在这里不是「害怕」，而是「恐怕/遗憾」，用来软化拒绝。口语高频：I'm afraid I can't make it.

sentenceAudio.text: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I'm busy.

items.sentence: Why don't we meet at the usual place?
items.translation: 我们在老地方见怎么样？
explanations:
**Why don't we...?** = 我们……怎么样？是提建议的常用句式。常见错误：
• "Why we don't meet" → 疑问句 don't 提前
• "Why don't we **to** meet" → 后接动词原形
**the usual place** = 老地方（双方都熟悉的地方）。usual 是形容词「惯常的」。

sentenceAudio.text: Why don't we meet at the usual place?

items.sentence: I'll pick you up at your place.
explanations:
**pick sb up** = 开车接某人。代词放中间：pick **you** up / pick **me** up。常见错误：
• "pick up **you**" → 代词必须放中间
• "pick you **upstairs**" → upstairs 是楼上，不是接你
**your place** = 你家（口语）。比较：at my place / at home。正式说法 your house / your apartment。

sentenceAudio.text: I'll pick you up at your place.

items.sentence: Could we reschedule for tomorrow instead?
explanations:
**reschedule** = 重新安排时间（re + schedule）。常见错误：
• "change the schedule" → 也可以，但 reschedule 更地道
• "reschedule **to** tomorrow" → 固定搭配是 for tomorrow
**instead** = 作为替代，放句末。完整意思：不是原定时间，而是改为明天。

sentenceAudio.text: Could we reschedule for tomorrow instead?

items.sentence: I'm running a bit late, sorry.
explanations:
**run late** = 迟到/时间赶不上（run 表「变得」，口语固定搭配）。常见错误：
• "I'm **arriving** late" → 可以但 run late 更口语
• "I'm late **running**" → 语序反了
迟到通知要主动：I'm running a bit late. / I'll be there in ten minutes.（十分钟到）

sentenceAudio.text: I'm running a bit late, sorry.

items.sentence: Shall we take a walk after dinner?
items.translation: 晚饭后我们去散散步好吗？
explanations:
**Shall we...?** = 我们……好吗？（英式常用，表提议）。常见错误：
• "Will we take a walk" → Shall we 才是标准提议句式
• "Shall we **to** take" → shall 后接动词原形
**take a walk** = 散步，固定搭配。同义：go for a walk / go for a stroll。美式更多说 Let's go for a walk.

sentenceAudio.text: Shall we take a walk after dinner?

items.sentence: I'll see you at the entrance at seven.
explanations:
**see you at + 地点 + at + 时间**：地点用 at，时刻用 at。常见错误：
• "see you **on** the entrance" → 地点在门口用 at 不用 on
• "at seven o'clock **pm**" → 口语说 at seven 即可
约定见面：地点 + 时间两个要素都要交代清楚。I'll see you there!（到那儿见！）

sentenceAudio.text: I'll see you at the entrance at seven.

items.sentence: I'm afraid I can't make it tonight.
items.translation: 恐怕今晚我抽不出时间。
explanations:
`I'm afraid...` 是委婉拒绝/告知坏消息的开场，不是真的害怕。常见错误：
• "I'm **afraid of** I can't" → afraid of 后接名词，接句子用 afraid (that)
• 直译成「我害怕」→ 语境是礼貌，不是恐惧

`make it` = 能到场/能成行。常见错误：
• "I can't **come** it" → 搭配是 make it，不是 come it
• "I can't **do** it" → do it 指做某事，make it 指能出席

sentenceAudio.text: I'm afraid I can't make it tonight.

items.sentence: Why don't we grab a bite to eat?
items.translation: 我们随便吃点东西怎么样？
explanations:
`Why don't we...` 是提建议的委婉句式，等于 Let's...。常见错误：
• "Why **we don't** grab" → 疑问句 don't 要提前
• "Why don't we **to** grab" → 后接动词原形
`grab a bite (to eat)` 是口语「随便吃点、填饱肚子」，非正式。bite 本义「一口」，这里指小吃。

sentenceAudio.text: Why don't we grab a bite to eat?

items.sentence: What time should we meet up?
explanations:
`What time` 问具体时刻（对比 When 问大概时间）。常见错误：
• "**Which** time should we" → 用 what 不是 which
• "What time **we should**" → 疑问句 should 提前
`meet up` 强调「见面、碰头」（尤指约定会面）。也可只用 meet，meet up 更口语化。

sentenceAudio.text: What time should we meet up?

items.sentence: Mind if I join you for lunch?
items.translation: 介意我跟你们一起吃午饭吗？
explanations:
`Mind if I...` = Do you mind if I... 的口语省略版。常见错误：
• 回答 "Yes" → 指「介意」，别让人家一起坐；不介意要说 No/Not at all
• "Mind **that** I join" → if 从句表条件，不用 that
`join sb` = 加入某人（一起做某事）。加入某活动可说 join sb for lunch / join the game。

sentenceAudio.text: Mind if I join you for lunch?

items.sentence: I'm supposed to meet him at six.
explanations:
`be supposed to` = 按计划/规定应该。常见错误：
• "suppose to" → 缺 be 且 supposed 不能省 d
• "I'm suppose to" → 漏 d

`at six` — 钟点前用 at。常见错误：
• "in six" → 钟点用 at（in 表在一段时间之后）

sentenceAudio.text: I'm supposed to meet him at six.

items.sentence: Would you like to grab dinner sometime?
items.translation: 改天一起吃个晚饭怎么样？
explanations:
`Would you like to...?` 比 Do you want to 更礼貌的邀约。常见错误：
• "Would you like dinner?" → 也可以但少了动作
• "Do you like to grab dinner" → like 表喜好不是邀约
`grab` = 匆匆吃点/随便吃。`sometime` = 某时（一个词），`some time` = 一些时间。

sentenceAudio.text: Would you like to grab dinner sometime?

items.sentence: Let's catch up over coffee this weekend.
items.translation: 这周末我们喝咖啡聊聊近况吧。
explanations:
`catch up` = 叙旧/聊近况。常见错误：
• "catch up **with each other**" → 也可，简说 catch up
• "catch **on**" → 那是赶上潮流
`over coffee` = 喝着咖啡（时）。`this weekend` 前不加介词。

sentenceAudio.text: Let's catch up over coffee this weekend.

items.sentence: Why don't you come over for dinner tonight?
items.translation: 今晚你过来一起吃晚饭吧？
explanations:
`Why don't you...?` = 建议/邀约。常见错误：
• "Why you don't" → 疑问句助动词提前
• "Why not come over" → 也可，省主语
`come over` = 到（某人）家来。

sentenceAudio.text: Why don't you come over for dinner tonight?

grammar.pos: go for a run 惯用短语

explanations:
`wanna` = want to 的连读写法，只用于非正式场合。常见错误：
• "Wanna to go" → wanna 已含 to，不能再加
• 书面写作要用 want to

`go for a run` 是固定搭配「去跑步」，整体是一个 chunk 不可拆。常见错误：
• "go for run" → 漏掉冠词 a
• "go to a run" → 介词是 for 不是 to
同义：Want to go running? / Feel like a run?

`be down for sth` 是口语习语，表「乐意、算我一个」，跟「在下面」无关。常见错误：
• "I'm down to it" → 固定搭配用 for
• 按字面理解成「我在下面」→ 会完全跑偏
`for it` 指代前面提到的那件事。同义：I'm in. / Count me in. / I'm up for it.

`hang out` = 一起消磨时间、闲逛，超常用。常见错误：
• 别写成 "hang on"，那是「等一下」
• "Let's hanging out" → Let's 后接动词原形
更随意：Wanna hang out? / Hang out sometime?
